title: Psionic asset tested with sphere that came off a craft

tellings.quote: I just interviewed a psionic asset yeah who has that story

plain: A person with claimed psychic powers, whom Michels calls a "psionic asset", is said to have been tested with a sphere that came off a craft. Michels mentions it only in passing, saying he had just interviewed someone who "has that story". He gives no name, place or date, and does not say what the test involved or what it showed. If true, it would mean psychic abilities were being tested against hardware from an unknown craft.
